The Household expenses page now follows dark mode. I swapped its hard-coded white background and dark text for the app's own theme colours, so it switches with the rest of the app. The pill backgrounds and divider lines changed the same way.

I didn't touch the layout or the note's data. I also haven't looked at it in dark mode myself. The previous version of the page is kept if you want to go back.
